text:
dev-ci-bot: CI perf alert: PR #14321 microbench 'kv-prefetch' exceeded threshold on linux-gpu-rt (throughput -12%). Full details: https://ci.internal/reports/14321

marta: looking now, reproduces locally on a 3090. quick numbers: baseline 12.1k toks/s -> PR 10.7k toks/s.

cheng: bisect points at commit 8e4b9f2 (kernel-selector: prefer fused_matmul for short seqs) as the first bad commit.

liam: that was my change — I heuristically force fused_matmul when avg_seq_len < 128 to reduce kernel launch overhead. didn't expect kv-prefetch path to be impacted.

julie: can you paste the microbench output and the seqlen distribution?

marta: sure — reproducer run (batcher microbench, 10 runs):
```
baseline: throughput=12100 tokens/s, kv_hit=0.72, avg_seq=90, p50=9.8ms, p99=42ms
PR-14321: throughput=10700 tokens/s, kv_hit=0.69, avg_seq=92, p50=11.2ms, p99=61ms
diff: -11.6% throughput, p99 +19ms
seqlen histogram: 1-32: 14%, 33-64: 34%, 65-128: 38%, 129+: 14%
kernel chosen timeline (sample): fused_matmul -> matmul_v2 -> fused_matmul -> matmul_v2
```

marta: also seeing increased KV eviction churn around the same window (more cache misses). logs: `kv_evictions=184 -> 337` under PR.

cheng: interesting — fused_matmul variant changes per-layer memory access pattern which might be altering prefetch timing and causing slightly different memory pressure. that could explain more evictions.

liam: ack. I missed the interaction with prefetch timing. quick mitigation: force old selector for requests with kv-usage attribute or when seqlen distribution heavy in mid-range. I'll try a targeted revert first.

ophelia: is this a rollout blocker for the stable branch? SLA for dedicated customers would be impacted if we ship.

julie: yes, it's a blocker for stable; we need a revert or a hotfix in the next hour, otherwise pause rollout.

dev-ci-bot: Created revert PR #14325 to revert 8e4b9f2 and triggered microbench matrix on canary nodes. https://ci.internal/pr/14325

liam: opening a follow-up PR with a guarded heuristic (only use fused when kv_prefetch==false OR avg_seq < 48). running local perf tests now.

marta: quick note: when reproducing, add `--kv-prefetch=1 --batch-dist=realistic` to the microbench to catch the eviction behavior. the default synthetic sampler hides the effect.

cheng: we'll also add a perf regression unit test around kv_eviction_count and throughput for the mid-seqlen distribution.

julie: thanks — I'll hold the canary rollout until the revert lands and CI green. tagging oncall: @ophelia. :eyes:

ophelia: oncall ack, monitoring alerts muted for rollout window to avoid noise. will watch the revert PR CI. :mag:

marta: after revert PR lands, let's run the 3-region perf sweep before unblocking.

liam: local quickfix improved throughput to 12040 toks/s in 10-run smoke — nearly baseline. will push tests in a minute.

dev-ci-bot: Revert PR #14325 merged by liam. Canary microbench schedule: queued.

marta: post-merge canary numbers look back to baseline on eu-west and us-east. closing loop — thanks all. :thumbsup:
